resources.string: Keeps the Galaxy Buds app connected to your Galaxy Buds over LE Audio: whenever your Buds connect, it reconnects the Buds app automatically. It works in the background on its own. You can close this window any time without affecting it.
Galaxy Buds app: waiting to see the next Buds connection
(changed since this helper was made. If the Buds app misbehaves, see Troubleshooting in the Buds LE Link README.)
Samsung Buds plugin installed and running in ARM mode
Buds LE Link lost its Nearby devices permission, so it can\'t notice your Buds connecting.
Battery optimization was turned back on for Buds LE Link.
Background activity is restricted for Buds LE Link.
Android may pause Buds LE Link if you don\'t open it for a few months.
Samsung\'s Buds plugin was reinstalled in Intel mode and will crash on this Googlebook. Reinstall it in ARM mode as described in the Buds LE Link README.
Your Buds are connected, but the Galaxy Buds app hasn\'t reconnected after several tries. Tap to try again; if that doesn\'t work, open Galaxy Wearable and tap Connect.
